title: Custodian: LLM Embarkation & Profile Assertion Workflow
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Goal: Build an end-to-end, auditable pipeline ("Custodian") for onboarding community LLM weights into Redwood's serving catalog and publishing a validated performance profile + canonical pin. Scope covers: weight intake, provenance & signature verification, automated conversion to runtime artifacts (float/quant variants), deterministic smoke suites, perf microbenchmarks, variant selection heuristic, pin recommendation, and profile publish to the model catalog.

Acceptance criteria:
- Ingested weight bundles are checksum-verified, signed, and stored with manifest + provenance.
- Conversion produces reproducible runtime artifacts for at least FP16 and an int8 candidate when supported.
- Deterministic validation (functional equivalence smoke) passes for the canonical variant with >95% reproducibility across 3 runs.
- Performance profile (latency P50/P95, throughput, memory, token cost) is published, with metadata for sequence lengths \u003c=512 and \u003e512.
- A pin (model_id@version) is created and linked to the profile and rollout policy.
- Rollout is gated: canary -> staged -> global with automated fallback to a compatible variant on regression.

Key design decisions made so far:
- Conversion: We will use a two-stage conversion flow. Stage 1: lightweight converter (fast) to generate a canonical runtime artifact for smoke and functional checks. Stage 2: full optimizer that runs kernel selection, quantization sweeps and emits multi-variant artifacts. This trades a slightly longer total pipeline time for early fast feedback.
- Determinism vs. coverage: To keep compute cost reasonable, smoke suites cover critical ops and 80% of model ops via sampled inputs; full determinism sweeps are only run for models that reach the candidate list.
- Pin heuristics: prefer variants with the smallest acceptable P95 latency under customer-tiered SLOs, but apply a quality penalty for any documented hallucination/regression signals in the eval set.

Telemetry & observability:
- Emit per-stage timing, error rates, token-level cost estimates, and sample traces to runtime-telemetry.
- Profile publish includes synthetic load curves and the deterministic-sweep diff report for audit.

Security and compliance:
- All artifacts must be scanned by the license scanner and the binary provenance flow.
- KMS-backed signing of pins and manifests.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal alpha: small set of known community models; artifacts stored in staging bucket; limited to infra engineers.
2) Beta: add sample OSS community models and enable canary in Hosted API for 2 customers.
3) GA: publish to catalog with UI entry and enabling automatic pin recommendations.

Detailed acceptance tests, smoke files, and canary prompts live in the design doc linked below.
